newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ROMA SNATCH 1-1 DRAW AGAINST JUVENTUS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMA SNATCH 1-1 DRAW AGAINST JUVENTUS.

text.p: Second half substitute Marco Delvecchio snatched a last minute equaliser on Saturday as Roma drew 1-1 with European champions Juventus in a remarkable Italian league match at the Olympic Stadium.
The draw left Juventus two points clear at the top.
The stadium exploded in delight as Delvecchio crashed in the equaliser with seconds to go, staving off as if by magic Roma's third consecutive defeat.

The home team were humiliated by lowly Verona last weekend and suffered a 3-0 drubbing by Karlsruhe in a UEFA Cup first leg match earlier in the month, increasing pressure on Argentine coach Carlos Bianchi.
Juventus had taken the lead through Michele Padovano in the 59th minute and seemed to have the win sewn up.

Padovano was ironically the only Juventus player on the field to have scored against Roma while playing for the Turin club -- he hit the 71st minute equaliser in last season's 2-2 draw, and he kept the record intact.
Croat striker Alen Boksic, who played home matches at the stadium for three years with Roma's city rivals Lazio, set up the goal with a cross from the edge of the area.

Padovano, with the rest of the Juventus team making his first appearance at the stadium since winning the European Cup there in May, gave young goalkeeper Giorgio Sterchele absolutely no chance with a strong, straight shot.
The draw left Juventus on 14 points, ahead of rivals Milan on 12, and in pensive mood ahead of a Champions' League clash with Rapid Vienna in Turin next Wednesday.

Milan and most other serie A clubs play on Sunday. The Roma-Juventus clash was brought forward one day to give Roma time to prepare for their second round, second leg UEFA match against Germany's Karlsruhe in Rome on Tuesday.
Roma, playing a nervous high-ball game in the first half, had several good chances in both halves.
But they looked too unsettled to make the most of their home advantage and frequently squandered the ball or failed to make the final touch to promising manoeuvres.
